compiled_state.description:
## Observation
- navapbc/homebrew-rebar `.github/workflows/autobump.yml` (workflow id 316476444) is in state `disabled_inactivity` (checked 2026-11-09). Its last run was a scheduled run on 2026-10-28 23:31 PDT.
- `Formula/rebar.rb` still points at the nava_rebar-0.13.1 sdist, although 0.14.0 was published to PyPI on 2026-10-30. The runbook's claim that the 6-hourly schedule self-heals a missed release does not hold while the workflow is disabled.
- GitHub disables scheduled workflows after 60 days with no repository activity. The tap's own bot commits apparently do not keep it active, because it only commits when a bump happens.

## Impact
Homebrew users stay 2 releases behind (0.13.1 while 0.14.0 and 0.15.0 are on PyPI), and `gh workflow run autobump.yml` (runbook step 3) cannot be dispatched.

## Remediation (operator)
Re-enable the workflow (`gh workflow enable autobump.yml --repo navapbc/homebrew-rebar`), then dispatch it. Separately, decide how to stop the inactivity disable from recurring (for example a keepalive, or moving the trigger into rebar's release.yml), and correct docs/releasing.md step 3.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] [non-codebase] autobump.yml is enabled and Formula/rebar.rb points at the latest PyPI sdist.
      provenance: environment=github.com navapbc/homebrew-rebar; principal=JoeOakhartNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — read via gh api of the workflow state and the formula contents
- [ ] docs/releasing.md step 3 states the inactivity-disable failure mode and its recovery.
compiled_state.title: Homebrew tap autobump disabled for inactivity; formula stuck at 0.13.1, missed 0.14.0
